conventions.pose: T_object_grasp: position and R place the grasp frame in the CAD/object frame. The robot commands T_base_grasp = T_base_camera @ T_camera_object @ T_object_grasp.
conventions.origin: where the tool's TCP must be at contact (suction: the cup face on the part; parallel: mid-way between the closed jaws, at mid plate thickness)
conventions.approach: unit direction the tool travels as it closes on the part; equal to the grasp frame's +Z (third column of R)
conventions.close_axis: parallel jaws translate along +/- this axis; equal to the grasp frame's +X (first column of R). For suction it only fixes the tool roll.
conventions.approach_m: free path the tool needs along -approach before contact; the length of the clearance cylinder
conventions.retreat_m: lift back along -approach after the grasp closes
conventions.tool_radius_m: radius of the tool envelope near the tip; the radius of the clearance cylinder
conventions.patch_radius_m: suction only: flat material the cup needs, radius
conventions.opening_width_m: parallel only: jaw separation at contact

measurements.note: every number below was measured from measured_from, not taken from a drawing; see the cell-integration report

grasps.name: suction_plate_top
grasps.note: plate top face, y = +0.0005 (1220 mm2 planar); largest circle clear of both 12.6 mm through-holes is r = 6.64 mm, centred here

grasps.name: suction_plate_bottom
grasps.note: plate bottom face, y = -0.0075 (1262 mm2 planar, one plane over the whole part); largest clear circle r = 10.25 mm here, so the same 12 mm cup keeps 4.2 mm of margin

grasps.name: parallel_stem_from_top
grasps.note: straddles the T stem across X. Jaw walls are the planar faces at x = -0.0096 and x = +0.0054 (169 mm2 each), both spanning the full 8.0 mm plate thickness over z = +0.0048..+0.0260

grasps.name: parallel_stem_from_bottom
grasps.note: same jaw walls as parallel_stem_from_top, approached from the plate's underside: a part lying boss-up presents only this side

grasps.name: parallel_crossbar_from_top
grasps.note: straddles the crossbar across Z at x = -0.0145, between the two through-holes and 31 mm clear of the boss. Jaw walls are the planar faces at z = -0.0171 (407 mm2) and z = +0.0029 (256 mm2), both spanning the full 8.0 mm plate thickness
